title: Reproducing Krzeminski et al. 2012: retarded oxidation of silicon nanowires

sample.paper: Not stated: wafer orientation, doping, bulk or SOI. “Si bulk (110)” labels only the planar reference line and the model's linear rate constant
sample.ours: FAMILY: Si_Nanowire; ORIENTATION: Si100 (as stored; no program reads it)
sample.note: Si100 is the stored value and is ours; the paper's only orientation is (110), for the planar line.

sample.paper: “nanobeams and nanowires of height 240 nm”; diameters “from 40 nm to 140 nm” in the text, about 30 to 230 nm on the axis of Figure 1(b)
sample.ours: SHAPE: nanowire; DIAMETER_NM: 30 to 230; HEIGHT_NM: 240 (recorded; no program reads it)
sample.note: Whether the plotted diameter is before oxidation is said for the beams (“previous width L”) and implied for the wires.

sample.paper: “The oxide growth on Si nanobeams of previous width L is clearly thicker than a SiNWs with the diameter d = L. A size dependent oxidation kinetic was not observed”
sample.note: No program for the flat sidewall of a nanostructure; the beams enter only as the rate in the variant below.

sample.paper: “silicon nanorings (concave nanostructure) with inner diameters of 70 nm and 430 nm” (caption); “inner radius” in the text
sample.note: A concave surface: the radial program is for a convex cylinder only.

sample.paper: Figure 1(a) curves start at about 5 nm at t = 0; not explained
sample.ours: written as 90 s of steam before time zero (assumed)

history.item: Top-down lithography and etch (details in Ref. 8)
history.paper: “With the current top-down fabrication capabilities, etched silicon nanostructures including nanobeams, nanorings and nanowires have been fabricated with a high resolution [8]”
history.ours: SHAPE and DIAMETER_NM on the sample
history.note: Lithography, etch chemistry, mask removal: deferred to Ref. 8, not in this paper.
Whether the native oxide was removed before oxidation is not said.

history.ours: RUN RampUp DURATION 900 TEMP 700->850 AMBIENT inert_N2
history.note: The paper describes no furnace cycle. A 15 min ramp from 700 °C in nitrogen is ours.

history.item: Oxide present at time zero (about 5 nm)
history.paper: Figure 1(a): every curve starts at about 5 nm at t = 0 (graph read); the origin is not explained
history.ours: RUN TimeZeroOxide DURATION 90 TEMP 850->850 AMBIENT steam
history.note: The radial program has no starting oxide. It is written as 90 s of steam before time zero, which grows about 5 nm on a flat sidewall; whether it is native oxide, ramp oxide or a fit offset is not known.

history.paper: “then wet oxidized at 850°C”; “nanobeams and nanowires of height 240 nm have been oxidized for 10 and 20 minutes”
history.ours: RUN WetOxidation DURATION 600 TEMP 850->850 AMBIENT steam
history.note: How the steam is made, its partial pressure and the flow are not stated; pure steam at 1 atm is ours. The stored recipe is this step alone.

history.ours: the history ends when the oxidation ends

history.item: Oxide thickness by SEM at mid-height
history.paper: “the oxide thicknesses have been measured in the middle of these vertical structures described in SEM images”
history.note: Tilted-view SEM for wires, cross-section for beams; no error bars.

history.paper: Extended Deal-Grove in cylindrical coordinates with stress-dependent reaction rate and diffusivity and a shear-thinning viscosity; (B/A)[110] 5.18e-09 nm/s, B0 2.68e-13 nm²/s, V_k 15 Å³, V_d 45 Å³, σ_c 1 GPa, η0 1.4e18 P at 850 °C (as printed)
history.ours: the radial program: Kao's cylindrical law with one lumped stress time, no stress on diffusion, linear viscosity
history.note: The printed constants are not usable as printed (units); the paper's model is not reproduced here.

steps.name: TimeZeroOxide
steps.label: Oxide present at time zero (about 5 nm)
steps.isl: RUN TimeZeroOxide DURATION 90 TEMP 850->850 AMBIENT steam
steps.paper: Figure 1(a): every curve starts at about 5 nm at t = 0 (graph read); the origin is not explained
steps.timing: about 5 nm at t = 0 on the figure; written as 1 to 300 s of steam before the stated time

steps.timing: 10 and 20 min in the text; 10 to 40 min on the axis of Figure 1(a). Whether each time is a fresh sample is not stated
